summary: Two backcountry skiers training for the Grand Traverse triggered an avalanche on Death Pass above Brush Creek, buried ~210 ft below the slide path; CBSAR night response reached the debris at 1:30 a.m. but could not enter due to hang fire; both bodies recovered Sunday afternoon via beacon search, 250-ft rope uphaul and CareFlight.
location: Death Pass, Brush Creek (Grand Traverse route)
notes: Victims: Owen Green, 27, and Michael Goerne, 37, both Aspen High School lacrosse coaches. Avalanche estimated ~8:30-8:45 a.m. from GPS tracks; CBSAR call at 8:02 p.m. Saturday. Assisted by Mt. Crested Butte PD, CB Fire Protection District, CareFlight of the Rockies (CareFlight 4), CB Ski Patrol, CB Avalanche Center/CAIC forecasters, Black Canyon climbing rangers.
